
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lulight/p/23169725" title="发布于 2026-09-30 14:43">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【App Service 】WebJobs 多实例实验：谁在运行，什么时候运行？</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>问题描述</h1>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">把 Azure App Service 扩展到 3 个实例后，WebJob 会不会也同时运行 3 份？</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">如果每天定时生成一份报表，会不会生成 3 份？</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">在门户里手动点击一次 Run，又会由哪个实例执行？</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="4">答案取决于 WebJob 的类型，不能仅根据 App Service 的实例数量判断。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="6"><strong>持续型默认在所有应用实例上运行；</strong></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="6"><strong>手动触发和定时触发每次由一个实例执行，不会因为应用有 3 个实例就广播执行 3 次。</strong></p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="8">这篇文章用同一个 PowerShell 脚本做对照实验，记录实例 ID、UTC 时间和运行批次，让“在哪个实例运行”可以直接从日志判断。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="8">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="8">问题解答</h1>
<p>门户中的三种常见用法是 <strong>Continuous</strong>、<strong>Triggered</strong>/<strong>Manual</strong> 和 <strong>Triggered</strong>/<strong>Scheduled</strong>。</p>
<p><a href="https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/app-service/overview-webjobs" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">微软文档</a>明确说明，Scheduled 也是 Triggered，只是触发来源从手动操作变成了时间计划。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="591" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930140004158-36988152.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>假设目标应用稳定运行在 3 个实例上，行为如下：</p>
<table class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">
<thead class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20">
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="20"><th>使用方式</th><th>底层类型</th><th>多实例下的运行方式</th><th>3 个实例时的稳定状态预期</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="22">
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="22">
<td>持续运行，Multi Instance</td>
<td>Continuous</td>
<td>默认在应用的每个实例上启动任务</td>
<td>3 份任务进程持续运行</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="23">
<td>持续运行，Single Instance</td>
<td>Continuous</td>
<td>配置 <code>is_singleton: true</code> 后，只在一个实例运行该任务</td>
<td>1 份任务进程持续运行</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="24">
<td>手动触发</td>
<td>Triggered</td>
<td>每次触发由平台选择一个实例执行</td>
<td>点击一次 Run，启动一份执行，不是三份</td>
</tr>
<tr class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="25">
<td>定时触发</td>
<td>Triggered</td>
<td>每个计划触发点由一个实例执行</td>
<td>正常情况下，每个触发点启动一份执行，不是三份<br><br></td>


</tr>


</tbody>

</table>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="27">这里的“一个实例”不意味着“永远固定在同一台机器”。下一次触发、实例替换或持续型单实例任务接管后，执行实例可能发生变化。</p>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="27">平台也不承诺手动触发会依次轮询 A、B、C，所以连续点击几次却一直落在 A 上，并不违反上述规则。</p>
<h2 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="27">实验准备</h2>
<p>在同一段PowerShell脚本中，输出当前webjob运行的时间，实例ID等信息，以判断它是多实例运行还是单实例运行。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">param</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(
    [ValidateRange(</span>1, 3600)][int]<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$HeartbeatSeconds</span> = 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    [ValidateRange(</span>0, 3600)][int]<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$WorkSeconds</span> = 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    [ValidateRange(</span>0, 10000)][int]<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$MaxHeartbeats</span> = 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    [string]</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$OutputRoot</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$ErrorActionPreference</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 'Stop'
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$instance</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBSITE_INSTANCE_ID</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$instance</span>) { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$instance</span> = 'local<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">azure' }
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$job</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBJOBS_NAME</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$job</span>) { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$job</span> = 'local-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">demo' }
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$type</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBJOBS_TYPE</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$type</span>) { <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$type</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 'triggered' }
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$session</span> = [guid]::<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">NewGuid().ToString('N')

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$OutputRoot</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBSITE_INSTANCE_ID</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:HOME</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$OutputRoot</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Join-Path</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:HOME</span> 'data\webjob-instance-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">demo'
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$OutputRoot</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Join-Path</span> ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) 'webjob-instance-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">demo'
    }
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$safeJob</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$job</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-replace</span> '[^a-zA-Z0-9_-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]', '_'
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$safeInstance</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$instance</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-replace</span> '[^a-zA-Z0-9_-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]', '_'
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$directory</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Join-Path</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Join-Path</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$OutputRoot</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$safeJob</span>) <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$safeInstance</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$null</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">New-Item</span> -ItemType Directory -Path <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$directory</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Force
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$logPath</span> = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Join-Path</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$directory</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">$session.jsonl</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> Write-Record([string]<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$EventName</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$record</span> = [ordered]@<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
        utc </span>= [DateTime]::<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">UtcNow.ToString('o')
        event </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$EventName</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        job </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$job</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        type </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$type</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        instance </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$instance</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        computer </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:COMPUTERNAME</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        processId </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$PID</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        session </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$session</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        platformRunId </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBJOBS_RUN_ID</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$line</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$record</span> | <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">ConvertTo-Json</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Compress
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Write-Output</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$line</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> One file per process session: instances never append to the same file.</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Add-Content</span> -LiteralPath <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$logPath</span> -Value <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$line</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Encoding UTF8
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> Test-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Shutdown {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBJOBS_SHUTDOWN_FILE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Test-Path</span> -LiteralPath <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:WEBJOBS_SHUTDOWN_FILE</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span> Wait-OrShutdown([int]<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$Seconds</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$i</span> = 0; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$i</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-lt</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$Seconds</span>; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$i</span>++<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (Test-Shutdown) { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Start-Sleep</span> -Seconds 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
}

Write</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Record 'START'
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$type</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-eq</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 'continuous') {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$count</span> = 0
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">while</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-not</span> (Test-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Shutdown)) {
        Write</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Record 'HEARTBEAT'
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$count</span>++
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> A finite limit is for LOCAL tests only. Azure continuous jobs restart.</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$MaxHeartbeats</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-gt</span> 0 <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-and</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$count</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">-ge</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$MaxHeartbeats</span>) { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">break</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
        Wait</span>-OrShutdown <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$HeartbeatSeconds</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
} </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Simulate a short task. This delay is not an exactly-once guarantee.</span>
    Wait-OrShutdown <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$WorkSeconds</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
}
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (Test-Shutdown) { Write-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Record 'STOP_REQUESTED' }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> { Write-Record '<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">END</span>' }</pre>
</div>
<p>把以上内容复制到文件 run.ps1&nbsp; 中，然后分别打包为四个zip文件：<strong>continuous-multi.zip</strong> ，&nbsp;<strong>continuous-single.zip</strong>，<strong>manual.zip</strong> 和&nbsp;<strong>scheduled.zip</strong>。</p>
<p>然后通过App Service的Web Job门户分别创建四个web job，参考在门户上创建WebJob的文档：<a href="https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/app-service/quickstart-webjobs?tabs=windows#add-the-webjob-in-the-azure-portal" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://docs.azure.cn/zh-cn/app-service/quickstart-webjobs?tabs=windows#add-the-webjob-in-the-azure-portal</a></p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="318" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930141722468-2024494596.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="27">实验结果</h2>
<p class="code-line" dir="auto" data-line="27">1：<strong>continuous-multi ， </strong>连续运行的多实例部署结果为，在3个实例上，这个webjob在每一个实例上都在执行。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="318" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930142411037-708107941.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>2：<strong>continuous-single， </strong>连续运行的单实例部署结果为，在3个实例的环境中，这个webjob只在一个实例上执行。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="221" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930142652926-408753614.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>3：<strong>manual</strong>，手动触发的webjob，在3个实例的环境中，每次只在一个实例上执行。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="340" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930144114071-1252541956.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4：<strong>scheduled</strong>，按时触发的webjob，在3个实例的环境中，每次只在一个实例上执行。只是，后一次执行的实例可能发生变化。</p>
<p><img alt="image" width="666" height="363" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2127802/202609/2127802-20260930143845318-1715998908.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
